Injury availability reshapes game scripts through depth chart shifts, increasing opponent leverage. Real-time tracking provides ground-truth efficiency adjustments that invalidate historical proxies. These three operators form a triadic causal lattice where each variable influences the others—air affects carry, injuries affect leverage, and tracking validates both. The failure mode occurs when one domain is ignored, leading to misalignment between prediction and reality. For example, ignoring air density leads to overestimation of deep-ball success, while ignoring injury data underestimates opponent strength. The system must maintain consistency across all domains to avoid spurious correlations.
